_about: The objectives reread (S649; Sam, 2026-11-13: "add objectives to the collection list of data from cors. they should be collected when slos are collected"). Every loaded college whose course SLOs are in course_outcomes and whose objectives are not, with what to do. kb/_course_outcomes_read.py files both kinds in the one pass on every read path; the reads below were filed before it took objectives (S584, 2026-11-05) and carry no objectives key. A full read files no page text, so none of them can be a reparse: each is read again. Runner minutes only, no model call, so the $40 extraction go never applies. One host at a time, most exhibit articulations first (the sum over the host's colleges, scripts/next_slo_colleges.py's count). Guarded by tests/course_outcomes_objectives_standing_test.py. Short form: objectives_reread_plan.md.

how.trigger: course-outcomes-read.yml and course-outcomes-load.yml start on a push to a claude/** branch that changes kb/course_outcomes/.run or kb/course_outcomes/.load from main's copy; neither has workflow_dispatch. The dispatch is a new branch off main carrying the trigger file's lines.
how.read: On a new branch claude/slo-objectives-<host> off main, write kb/course_outcomes/.run with the read lines (run= takes the date), commit with a message that does not start with Merge, push, open a draft PR. The slices run one at a time and commit back to the branch.
how.load: When every slice is filed complete (scripts/next_slo_colleges.py --college <slug> says load), write kb/course_outcomes/.load with the load lines on the same branch and push. kind=objective posts the objective rows only; the reread's SLO rows are held back and counted in the receipt.
how.one_host: Start a host's read only when the previous host is loaded or stopped. Never two readers on one host: Coastline and Golden West share catalog.cccd.edu and run in turn.
how.merge: Merge on a passing test once the receipt is on the branch (step 11 of docs/reference/scheduled_sessions.md).

undo.receipt: kb/receipts/course_outcomes_<host>_<load run>.json: {host, load_run, kind: "objective", held_back, posted, inserted, kept, inserted_keys: [{id, college, course_code, kind: "objective"}], rollback: "delete from public.course_outcomes where id in (...);"}
undo.how: Run the receipt's rollback statement: it deletes exactly the ids that load inserted, every one kind objective (Rule 10 a2).
undo.never_replaces: course_outcomes_load() is insert-only (on conflict (college, course_code, source_url, kind, fingerprint) do nothing), and kind is part of the key, so an objective row never updates or replaces an SLO row; with kind=objective no SLO row is posted at all.
